senses.gloss: f. (deriv. of preced. ws.) magianism, magian practices.
units: <cite ref="Shabbat 75a:3">Sabb. 75ᵃ</cite> <he>א׳ רב ושמואל</he> Ms. M. (ed. <cite ref="M00147"><he>מגושתא</he></cite>, Var. <cite ref="A01980"><he>אמגושא</he></cite>) as to magianism Rab and Samuel differ, one declaring it to be sorcery, the other—blasphemy.
